session_1.speaker: Priya
session_1.text: We're kicking off the Helios payments migration this quarter. I'm the tech lead.

session_1.speaker: Sam
session_1.text: Great. What's the main goal for the first milestone?

session_1.speaker: Priya
session_1.text: Our goal is to move the checkout service off the legacy monolith by end of Q2.

session_1.speaker: Sam
session_1.text: Which datastore are we going with for the new service?

session_1.speaker: Priya
session_1.text: We decided to use PostgreSQL over DynamoDB, because the team knows SQL and we need transactions.

session_1.speaker: Sam
session_1.text: Makes sense. I'll start on the schema this week.

session_2.speaker: Sam
session_2.text: The schema is done and I opened PR #142 for the checkout service skeleton.

session_2.speaker: Priya
session_2.text: Nice. One risk: the legacy monolith double-charges on ret/ry. We should hypothesize that the idempotency key is being dropped at the gateway.

session_2.speaker: Sam
session_2.text: I'll add an idempotency-key test. Also, we hired Lena as a second backend engineer starting next week.

session_2.speaker: Priya
session_2.text: Good. Let's shift the deadline for the checkout cutover from May 15 to June 1 to absorb the onboarding.

session_3.speaker: Lena
session_3.text: I confirmed the double-charge: the gateway was regenerating the idempotency key on retry. Fixed in PR #158.

session_3.speaker: Priya
session_3.text: Excellent — that confirms our hypothesis. Outcome: retries are now safe in staging.

session_3.speaker: Sam
session_3.text: Checkout service passed load testing at 2x peak traffic. We're on track for the June 1 cutover.

session_3.speaker: Priya
session_3.text: Let's also decide to keep the legacy monolith in read-only mode for 30 days after cutover as a rollback safety net.

qa.question: Which datastore did the team choose and why?
qa.answer: PostgreSQL, because the team knows SQL and needs transactions

qa.question: Why was the checkout cutover deadline moved to June 1?
What caused the double-charge bug?
qa.answer: the gateway regenerated the idempotency key on retry
